source.dramatic_purpose: Show Haeun as a small cautious figure entering a vast secret rooftop space.

camera.position: above the west service stairs looking diagonally toward the greenhouse and sea
camera.focus: Haeun paused at the threshold and the distant bottle shelves

subjects.pose: half turned toward the rooftop, one hand still on the door
subjects.gaze: toward the bottle shelves on frame right
subjects.action: steps through the open rooftop door after folding her umbrella

background.description: rain-dark school rooftop, glass greenhouse to the south, bottle shelves and gutter along the east wall, gray-blue sea beyond the parapet
background.perspective: strong diagonal lines pull from the west stairs to the east bottle shelves
background.lighting: cool rainy dusk with warm weak greenhouse spill

art_direction.line: controlled clean webtoon linework with delicate rain accents
art_direction.color: cool desaturated blue-gray scene with small amber focal accents
art_direction.rendering: polished 2D cel shading with soft atmospheric depth
art_direction.composition: use large negative space above and around Haeun; make the bottle shelves visible but not yet dominant

state_out: she looks toward the east shelf
